readme: Allowlist for scripts/lint_docs.py (ruthless_pipeline/certification/doc_lint.py). Each entry suppresses findings for one path (+ optional check and line-substring filter) where the flagged text is INTENTIONAL history or planned-future reference, not unauthorized staleness. Add entries only with a concrete reason.

allow.reason: FROZEN preregistration (hash-pinned in docs/D2-0005_FREEZE_CANDIDATE.json, sha256 5a26c083...). Its 'D2-0004 is open' gating language was true at freeze time and cannot be edited without breaking the freeze; staleness is explicitly resolved by docs/PREREGISTRATION_D2-0005_AMENDMENT_A5.md Addendum.

A5 quotes the frozen preregistration's stale lines verbatim in order to resolve them (see its 'Addendum — Resolution of stale "D2-0004 still open" lines'); the quotation and resolution are the intended record.
Historical log entry retained unchanged for provenance; explicitly superseded by the 2026-09-08 status-update entries in the same file.

allow.match: the authorized re-run of RAC-PER-D2-0004. Until it closes
allow.reason: Historical log entry written while the authorized D2-0004 re-run was live; explicitly superseded by the 2026-09-08 status-update entry in the same file and retained unchanged for provenance.
Meta-entry quoting a superseded historical entry's 'IN PROGRESS' wording in order to retract it; retained unchanged for provenance.

Forward-looking UX spec whose 'D2-0004 open' text is (a) verbatim quotation of the frozen preregistration header cited as incident source and (b) illustrative mock-UI copy for the dependency-gate display, keyed to the historical incident at commit b4fe0e5, not a live status claim.
Backlog note quoting the frozen preregistration's gating rule verbatim (marked as a quote with source pointer); the quote is the intended citation, not a status claim.

Planned future artifact path: the rehearsal ICC results file is produced only when the D2-0005 rehearsal runs; the packet describes where it WILL live. D2-0005 is not armed, so the artifact cannot exist yet.
Planned future artifact path (rehearsal output); cannot exist before the D2-0005 rehearsal runs.
Planned future artifact path (primary comparison output); cannot exist before D2-0005 is armed and executed.
Barrier-0 planning handoff; backticked paths are prospective deliverables for future waves (do not exist yet by design).
Roadmap document; backticked paths are planned future files (schemas, modules, artifacts) that do not exist yet by design.
Gap-analysis document; backticked paths name missing/planned components whose absence is the subject of the analysis.
